mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy accommodates economic growth.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return distribution in declining FEDFUNDS periods shows no statistically significant positive mean (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 7.0% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger equity sell-offs due to reduced consumer spending, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0% (over 3-year rolling window), or the signal fails to show statistical significance (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, driving positive equity returns through accelerated corporate earnings growth; the interaction effect requires both series to exceed their 3-month moving averages.
failure_condition: The interaction term between HOUST and RSAFS is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression of 20-day returns, or the signal fails to produce positive returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of accelerating industrial production (INDPRO growth rate > 1.5% quarterly), manufacturing output expansion fuels corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return distribution in strong industrial expansion periods shows no statistically significant positive mean (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in real GDP (GDPC1) signals expanding economic activity that raises corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return distribution in GDPC1 growth periods shows no statistically significant positive mean (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index exceeds 215, it indicates accelerating inflation that triggers central bank rate hikes, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 215 (over 3-year rolling window), or the signal fails to show statistical significance (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low employment growth (PAYEMS growth rate < 0.5% monthly) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 6.5%) signal a weak labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days; the interaction effect requires both conditions to be met.
failure_condition: The interaction term between PAYEMS and UNRATE is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression of 20-day returns, or the signal fails to produce negative returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.0% and sustained for 3 months), higher interest rates reduce equity valuations by increasing discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and FEDFUNDS rising for 3 months
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return distribution in monetary tightening cycles shows no statistically significant negative mean (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
